https://www.premiumtimesng.com/features-.summary_zh: 2026年10月29日，索科托天主教教区主教Matthew Hassan KUKAH主教在Epe的Augustine University发表开学训词。接下来几分钟，我想请大家注意我们所面临的挑战；借用著名的美国《独立宣言》中的说法，这些挑战被称为对幸福的追求。第7段：对幸福的追求是一项个人事业，但只有在与他人建立联系时才能充分体验其中，而其中大多数人对你而言都是完全陌生的人。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/features-.body: Convocation Lecture delivered at Augustine University, Epe, By Bishop Matthew Hassan KUKAH, CON, Bishop, Catholic Diocese of Sokoto on October 29, 2026. Your Grace, Archbishop Adewale Martins, Archbishop of Lagos, Vice President of the CBCN and Visitor of the University, Distinguished Pro Chancellor, Dame Winifred Akpani, an outstanding amazon in the private sector, other Members of the Governing Council, the Vice Chancellor, Rev. Professor Anthony Akinwale, OP, Deputy Vice Chancellor, Deans of Faculties, Registrar, other Principal officers and key members of staff, please do accept my hearty congratulations on this august occasion. Thank you for the honour of your kind invitation. Parents, Guardians, family Members, friends of the university and all the students of the university. 1: People of my generation grew up with what in those days was called, The Penny Catechism, a little booklet that covered the basic doctrine of the Catholic Church . A good memory of its contents was a condition for getting baptized. We didn’t quite understand the deeper theological issues but we repeated the answers with gusto. The first question in that little book asked: Who made you? The answer, God made me. The second question, Why did God make you? The answer, God made me to love him, to serve him and to be happy with him in heaven. 2: Heaven has been projected as a place of ultimate happiness, rest, bliss, and peace in the presence of God forever. This is on condition of course that we keep His commandments and do His will. Hence, when people die, we often say and pray that they have gone to be at peace with the Lord. St. Paul says that with thoughts such as these, we should console one another [1 Thes.4:18]. However, we are still here on earth, children of two cities. A musician once warned that: You make your heaven or hell here on earth. In moments of happiness, some people often say, they felt as if they were in heaven on their wedding day. Caught in the web of suffering, some people say they feel like they are living in hell! Yet, on the final judgment day, Jesus says that getting to heaven or hell is tied to our actions here on earth [Matt. 25:31ff]. 3: Between life here on earth and heaven or death, so much happens and a lot of it is based on the personal choices we make. A good life here on earth or in getting to heaven all depend on obedience to both the laws of God and civil laws. Many would argue that keeping the laws of God already makes living under civil authorities easier. This is why St. Augustine is credited with a most radical statement which says, Love God and do whatever you will. This is not a license to be irresponsible. Rather, it simply amplifies John when he says, if we are of God, we cannot sin [1 Jn 3:9]. My interest in the next few minutes is to try and call your attention to the challenges of what, to borrow the words from the famous American Declaration of Independence, they refer to as, the pursuit of happiness. Graduating from a prestigious Catholic university such as yours, named after the greatest theologian ever to come out of Africa, we would hope that you have been equipped with the most sound moral tools to navigate through life. As I have grown older, I have come to see that how we define happiness eventually determines what we pursue, what we love and what we build. 4: Therefore, Augustine University Class of 2026, let me add my voice to the voices of your parents and family, your teachers, and all those whose hard work has brought you to this day. Many of you arrived at this institution much younger and largely inexperienced and strangers to one another. It is my hope that all of you are now better human beings, more mature, have made more friends and are prepared to face the next phase of your life which starts right now. Today, you will party, believing you are now free from examinations. In many prestigious universities around the world, students have often suffered self-inflicted physical harm or even lost their lives in the course of these post graduate orgies. I enjoin you to calm down, listen to your senior brother, Kiss Daniel. If you plan to be rich till you die, please wear face mask! The real battle of your life is just about to start. 5: Some years back, in an address such as this to students in an American university, the then first lady, Michelle Obama told the graduands a story about her children. She said she often asks her children what sports they like or dislike. She said she would often ask them to go and learn how to play the game they didn’t like. The lesson for the children is: Life is never going to give you only the things you want. You will meet people you don’t like in school or one place of work or the other. The world will not shift its furniture to accommodate your needs. So, while you have the chance, make new friends, learn a new language, taste new food, in short, try different things. Do not despise the food, language, or culture of your new hosts. Life will embrace you if you open up to new ideas. 6: Until I came to Lagos, the idea people ate snail was revolting to me. Time passed, a series of visits to families and friends, offers here and there. I finally succumbed. The late Archbishops Ganaka, Jatau, Bishops Aje and Abba used to make fun of me, saying that I have come to disgrace the north in Lagos. They would say I have been contaminated by the Yorubas. Today, I have successfully converted a few of our bishops from the north to the delicacy of snails! I am counting on Archbishop Martins to help me convert his two friends, President of Conference, Archbishop Ndagoso and Archbishop Kaigama, former President of Conference. Snail may be a matter of taste. There are other choices in life that cannot simply be reduced to taste. 7: The pursuit of happiness is a personal enterprise, but lived fully in relation to others, most of them complete strangers to you. I have seen young men and women who found themselves in different parts of Nigeria among different people, forced to eat foods they had never imagined, forced to drink water from streams away from the comfort of their silver faucets at home. I have seen people who held others outside their ethnicity in contempt turn around to settle among these people. Today, through university life, away from the womb of family and ethnic comfort, many have ended up falling in love and marrying women and men of ethnic or religious groups they held in contempt. I am hopeful that many of you have made friends from other parts of Nigeria from different social strata other than yours. Please keep these friendships and expand your social networks. You never know where you will end up and whom you will encounter tomorrow. For your teachers, it is important that you know that one of these young men or women could be your President, Senator or Governor tomorrow. He or she could be your son or daughter in law. 8: As young people, it is easy to become frustrated and dejected in Nigeria because of the moral chaos around us. We now live in a society that is on a moral free fall. From top to bottom, we are a nation averse to obeying laws. Those we relied on for leadership and example are doing far worse. If you ask an average Nigerian how to secure admission into a university, how to get a first class, how to secure a job after you have graduated with a first class, you are more likely to be told, it all depends. A young generation of Nigerians and their parents are convinced that nothing can come to you because of merit and that every opportunity depends on whom you know not what you know. From breaking the law without consequences to living out a prison sentence, everything can be negotiated. Enter a culture of moral relativism. A compass whose north changes according to who is holding it cannot guide anyone home. 9: It is against this background that the japa syndrome came in as a solution. It became a rave and a deluge. Young people were sold the story of an El Dorado abroad, everywhere was paradise except Nigeria. For the better part of the last ten or so years, both the Atlantic Ocean and the Sahara Desert opened up as graveyards that swallowed the bodies and dreams of thousands of our young people. In truth, over the years, many young people have found a new life abroad and we thank God for that. Migration is a human event and is part of our civilization. I was therefore interested when Pope Leo, speaking to university students in Cameroon, acknowledged the understandable desire of young Africans to migrate in search of a better future. Yet he asked them to have “an ardent desire to serve your country” and to use what they had learnt for the benefit of their fellow citizens. Some of you will leave Nigeria. Some will stay. Wherever you go, remain builders. But do not conclude too quickly that nothing can be built here. 10: Class of 2026, this is a time for you to make the most important decisions in your life. The consequences of some of the choices you make now will live with you forever. Now is the time to reflect on the kind of life you wish to live, single or married, the children you may have, the career you will embrace, the dreams you will have. Pack the tool kit for your pursuit of happiness well. So, think well, pray well and choose well. Your pursuit of happiness is a legitimate enterprise that you cannot outsource to someone else because it is the basis for human flourishing and part of taking responsibility for your life. 11: The conditions under which we take that responsibility are also shaped by the society in which we live. When the Americans wrote the Declaration of Independence in 1776, they stated that: We hold these truths to be self-evident, that all men are created equal and that they are endowed by their creator with certain inalienable rights, that among these are life, liberty and the pursuit of happiness. The document went on to say that governments are set up precisely to enhance the prospects of the pursuit of happiness by citizens. The legitimacy of every government is based on its ability to create suitable conditions for the pursuit of happiness of all citizens. Exactly what constitutes happiness, who sacrifices what for the attainment of someone else’s happiness, these are the issues around which governance revolves. Here, constitutions and other state laws are often made to ensure that there is a level playing field for the attainment of these rights which are defined as being inalienable. They are inalienable because they are not the free gift of some benevolent dictator no matter the size of his army or source of power. This is why elections when well conducted, allow citizens to decide who can best help secure their happiness. 12: When Rev. Martin Luther King delivered his famous, I Have a Dream Speech on August 28, 1963, he called attention to the contradiction between these promises of equality in both the Declaration of Independence and the Constitution and how they related to the conditions of black people in America. He employed searing metaphors to make his case. He said that black people had gathered to dramatize a shameful condition to which America had subjected them and that they had come to the nation’s capital to cash a cheque. He said both documents were promissory notes that would guarantee the inalienable rights of life, liberty and the pursuit of happiness to all citizens. However, he said, black people went to cash this cheque and it was returned to them on grounds that the banks had insufficient funds! He categorically said: We refuse to accept that the bank can have insufficient funds and, he stated three times, We cannot be satisfied. Government can build the road, but the citizen must still walk it. Of course, we cannot blame people for failing to arrive where no road was built. 13: What does this say to us? It is that the fight for our dignity, the pursuit of happiness, is a moral call.
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/features-.title_zh: 在道德相对主义的世界中追求幸福，作者：马修·哈桑·库卡
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/features-.body_zh:
2026年10月29日，Matthew Hassan KUKAH主教(CON)在天主教索科托教区主教任内，于埃佩的Augustine University主持开学典礼并发表演讲。尊敬的Adewale Martins枢机主教，拉各斯总主教、CBCN副主席兼大学校监，尊敬的校务委员会主席Dame Winifred Akpani，私营领域的杰出女杰，其他治理委员会成员，校长Rev. Professor Anthony Akinwale, OP，副校长，各学院院长，注册主任，其他主要官员及教职员工核心成员，请在这个庄严的日子接受我衷心的祝贺。感谢你们盛情邀请我前来。各位家长、监护人、家庭成员、大学的亲友以及全体学生：

1：我们这一代人小时候所受的教育来自一本当时称作《便士教义问答》的小册子，其中讲述了天主教会的基本信理。能够熟记其中的内容，是接受洗礼的条件。我们并未完全理解其中更深的神学问题，却热情洋溢地背诵答案。那本小册子的第一个问题是：“是谁创造了你？”答案是：“上帝创造了我。”第二个问题是：“上帝为什么创造你？”答案是：“上帝创造我，是为了让爱他、侍奉他，并与他一同在天堂享福。”

2：天堂一直被描绘为永远与上帝同在、享有终极幸福、安宁、极乐与平安的地方。当然，这以我们遵守祂的诫命、实行祂的旨意为前提。因此，人们去世时，我们常说，也常祈祷他们已与主同享安宁。圣保罗说怀着这样的思想，我们应当互相安慰[1 Thes.4:18]。然而，我们仍在世上生活，是两座城邦的子民。一位音乐家曾提醒我们：“你是在今世造就自己的天堂或地狱。”在幸福时刻，有些人常说自己仿佛在婚礼当天置身天堂；被苦难之网困住时，有些人则说自己仿佛生活在地狱里！然而，在最后审判之日，耶稣说，进入天堂还是地狱，取决于我们在世上的行为[Matt. 25:31ff]。

3：在世上的生活与进入天堂或死亡之间，会发生许多事情，其中很大一部分取决于我们所作的个人选择。今世过上好生活，或最终进入天堂，都取决于同时遵守上帝的律法与民事法律。许多人会认为，遵守上帝的律法，本就能让生活在民事 authorities 之下变得更容易。因此，圣奥古斯丁被认为说过一句极为大胆的话：“爱上帝，并去做你愿意做的事。”这并非允许人们不负责任，而是进一步阐明约翰所说的话：如果我们属于上帝，就不能犯罪[1 Jn 3:9]。接下来几分钟，我想请大家注意一个问题，借用美国著名《独立宣言》的话说，这就是他们所谓的“追求幸福”所面临的挑战。你们从像贵校这样享有声誉的天主教大学毕业，而贵校以非洲有史以来最伟大的神学家命名，因此我们希望，你们已经获得了最可靠的人生道德工具。随着年岁增长，我逐渐认识到，我们如何定义幸福，最终决定了我们追求什么、热爱什么以及建设什么。

4：因此，Augustine University 2026届毕业生们，请让我与你们父母、家人、老师以及所有凭借辛勤努力将你们送到今天的人一道，为你们送上祝愿。你们中许多人初入这所学校时年纪小得多，几乎毫无经验，彼此也都很陌生。我希望如今你们都已更加完善、更加成熟，结交了更多朋友，并准备迎接从此刻开始的下一人生阶段。今天，你们会举办庆祝活动，认为自己终于摆脱了考试。在世界各地许多名牌大学里，学生常常在毕业后的狂欢中使自己遭受身体伤害，甚至丧命。我劝你们冷静下来，听听学长Kiss Daniel的话。如果你们打算富到终老，请戴上口罩！你们人生真正的战斗才刚刚开始。

5：多年前，在美国一所大学面向学生发表类似演讲时，时任第一夫人米歇尔·奥巴马向毕业生的孩子们讲过一则故事。她说自己常问孩子们喜欢或不喜欢哪些运动，还常让他们去学习如何参与自己不喜欢的项目。孩子们从中得到的启示是：人生不会只给你想要的东西。你会遇见学校里或某个工作场所里你并不喜欢的人；这个世界不会为你挪动家具来迁就你的需要。因此，趁还有机会，要结交新朋友、学习一门新语言、品尝新食物，简而言之，要尝试不同的事物。不要鄙视新东道主的食物、语言或文化。只要你敞开心扉接纳新思想，人生也会拥抱你。

6：在我来到拉各斯之前，人们吃蜗牛这件事在我看来令人作呕。时间流逝，我一次次拜访家人和朋友，到处有人请我吃，最后我还是没能抵挡住。已故的Ganaka、Yatau两位总主教以及Aje、Abba两位主教过去常取笑我，说我到拉各斯来给北方丢脸了，还会说我已经被约鲁巴人同化。如今，我已成功说服北方的几位主教改吃蜗牛这道美味！我正指望Martins枢机主教帮我把另外两位朋友也拉下水来，即 Conference 主席Ndagoso总主教，以及前 Conference 主席Kaigama总主教。蜗牛或许只是个人口味的问题，但人生中还有其他选择，不能仅仅归结为口味。

7：追求幸福是一项个人事业，但必须在与他人——其中大多数人对你完全陌生——的关系中充分实现。我见过一些青年男女，发现自己身在尼日利亚不同地方，置身不同的人群之中，被迫食用自己从未想象过的食物，被迫喝远离家中舒适银色水龙头、在溪流中取用的水。我也见过一些原本鄙视其他族群的人，转而定居在这些人的中间。如今，通过大学生活，远离家庭与族群舒适的襁褓，许多人最终爱上了并娶了原本令他们鄙视的族群或宗教群体的女子与男子。我希望你们中许多人已经结识了来自尼日利亚其他地区、不同社会阶层的朋友。请珍惜这些友谊，并拓展你们的社交网络。你们永远不知道最终会落脚何地，明天会遇见谁。对你们的老师而言，要明白这些青年男女中的一人，明天可能成为你们的总统、参议员或州长，也可能是你们的儿子或女婿。

8：作为年轻人，在尼日利亚很容易因周围的道德混乱而感到沮丧和灰心。我们如今生活在一个道德自由落体的社会里。从上到下，我们这个国家都不愿遵守法律。我们原本指望他们提供领导与榜样的人，表现却糟糕得多。如果你问一个普通尼日利亚人如何考入大学、如何拿到一等学位、如何在以一等学位毕业后找到工作，你更可能得到的回答是：“全靠关系。”尼日利亚年轻一代及其父母深信，没有什么能凭才 merit 落到你身上，每次机会都取决于你认识谁，而不是你懂什么。从违法却不受惩罚，到服刑期间也可以交易，没有什么不能协商。走进一种道德相对主义文化吧。一枚指南针若会因持握者不同而改变南北方向，就无法为任何人指引归途。

9：正是在这种背景下，japa综合征作为一种解决方案出现了，并迅速演变成风潮与洪流。有人向年轻人兜售一个故事：海外处处都是黄金国，除了尼日利亚，哪里都是乐园。在过去近十年的大部分时间里，大西洋和撒哈拉沙漠都变成了坟场，吞没我们成千上万年轻人的躯体与梦想。事实上，多年来，许多年轻人在海外找到了新生活，我们为此感谢上帝。移民是人类社会的事件，也是我们文明的一部分。因此，教皇Leo在喀麦隆向大学学生讲话时，承认非洲青年为寻求更美好未来而迁移的愿望可以理解，我对此很感兴趣。然而，他要求他们怀着“热切的服务祖国之心”，并运用自己学到的知识造福同胞。你们中有些人将离开尼日利亚，有些人将留下。无论去哪里，都要继续建设，但不要仓促认定这里什么都建不起来。

10：2026届毕业生们，这是你们人生中作出最重要决定的时刻。现在作出的某些选择，其后果将伴随你们一生。现在是时候反思自己希望过怎样的生活，是单身还是已婚，可能会有怎样的孩子，将从事怎样的事业，会怀有怎样的梦想。请认真整理好追求幸福所需的工具箱。因此，要慎重思考、虔诚祈祷并作出明智选择。追求幸福是一项正当事业，不能外包给他人，因为这是人类繁荣的基础，也是承担人生责任的一部分。

11：我们承担责任所处的环境，也受到所处社会塑造。1776年，美国人撰写《独立宣言》时指出：“我们认为以下真理不言而喻：人人生而平等，造物主赋予他们若干不可剥夺的权利，其中包括生命、自由和追求幸福的权利。”文件接着说，政府的设立，正是为了增进公民追求幸福的前景。每个政府的合法性，都建立在其能否为所有公民创造适合追求幸福的环境之上。究竟什么构成幸福，为实现他人的幸福谁应作出牺牲，这些正是治理所围绕的核心问题。在这一过程中，人们制定宪法及其他国家法律，往往是为了确保这些被界定为不可剥夺的权利能够在公平的环境中实现。它们之所以不可剥夺，是因为无论某个独裁者的军队多庞大、权力来源为何，都不是他无偿赐予的赠礼。因此，妥善举行的选举能够让公民决定谁最能帮助维护他们的幸福。

12：Rev. Martin Luther King于1963年8月28日发表著名的《我有一个梦想》演讲时，提醒人们注意《独立宣言》和《宪法》中关于平等的承诺，与美国黑人的处境之间的矛盾。他运用尖锐的隐喻阐明观点。他说，黑人聚集起来，是为了展示美国加诸他们的一种可耻处境，他们来到国家首都，是要兑现一张支票。他说，这两份文件都是期票，保证所有公民都享有生命、自由和追求幸福的不可剥夺权利。然而，他们前去兑现这张支票时，却因银行资金不足而被退回！他斩钉截铁地说：“我们拒绝接受银行资金不足的说法”，并三次强调：“我们不能接受。”政府可以修筑道路，但公民仍须自己走完这条路。当然，对于没有道路可走而未能抵达目的地的人，我们不能责怪他们。

13：这对我们意味着什么？这意味着，为我们的尊严而战、为幸福而追求，是一项道德召唤。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary: Lawmaker's visa issued 1 day before departure The delay of U.S. visa issuance for a ruling party lawmaker has become a topic of debate between rival parties over whether it is a sign of growing friction in the Korea-U.S. alliance. The main opposition People Power Party (PPP) called the incident a clear sign of eroded trust within the alliance.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary_zh: 议员出发前一天才获发签证 美国延迟向执政党议员签发签证，引发朝野两党争论：这是否表明韩美同盟的摩擦正在加剧。主要反对党国民力量党（PPP）称，这一事件清楚显示同盟内部信任遭到侵蚀。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: Lawmaker's visa issued 1 day before departure The delay of U.S. visa issuance for a ruling party lawmaker has become a topic of debate between rival parties over whether it is a sign of growing friction in the Korea-U.S. alliance. The main opposition People Power Party (PPP) called the incident a clear sign of eroded trust within the alliance. "It is a symbolic moment that clearly exposes the widening rift in the Korea-U.S. alliance and the total breakdown of trust between the two countries,” Rep. Park Sung-hoon, senior spokesperson for the PPP, said in a statement Saturday. “It is an unprecedented diplomatic embarrassment and a national disgrace that the chairman of Korea's parliamentary defense committee was required to submit an English translation of a past National Security Act conviction and a criminal record check to the U.S., our ally, before finally receiving entry permission,” Park wrote. Park's statement came after Rep. Jin Sung-joon of the ruling Democratic Party of Korea (DPK), the chairman of the Assembly's National Defense Committee, announced that his visa was issued belatedly, a day before the committee's planned departure for the U.S. Pacific Command in Hawaii. Jin said Wednesday that he received a visa refusal notice and expressed regret, saying his trip was not personal but official, aimed at meeting government and military officials in the U.S. The exact reason for the denial was unknown, but some observers assumed that it was in relation to the lawmaker’s 1980s violation of the National Security Law, which is common among former pro-democracy protesters. Jin's was the second such case, as former DPK leader Rep. Jung Chung-rae also had visa delays last month, eventually forcing him to change his parliamentary inspection itinerary to Europe. Jung was involved in anti-U.S. activities in the 1980s. "Jin may board the plane to Hawaii as if nothing happened, but it does not remove the current shaky state of the alliance," Park wrote. The DPK pushed back against the claims, accusing the PPP of politicizing the issue rather than supporting parliamentary duties. "When legitimate parliamentary activities have been hindered, how can the PPP attack their own fellow lawmaker? The PPP has no interest in protecting the national interest," Rep. Lee Ju-hee, floor spokesperson for the DPK, said in a statement Saturday, urging the PPP to apologize for politicizing the matter. DPK spokesperson Shin Hyun-young also said the PPP "should refrain from making remarks that would harm the Korea-U.S. alliance or trying to drive a wedge between Seoul and Washington.” As to the visa issue, U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio, meanwhile, implied that it was an “individual” case based on past behavior. “I think there was one particular visa individually that there was an issue about regarding behavior, perhaps a couple of decades ago. But we'll work through that at a bilateral basis, not in a press conference,” Rubio told reporters Saturday (local time) during a press conference following a G20 foreign ministers' meeting in Atlanta. His comments came after he had a meeting with Korean Foreign Minister Cho Hyun, who said last week before his departure to the U.S. that he would discuss the issue with Rubio
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: 随着围绕联盟的政治角力浮现，美国签证签发延迟问题成为焦点
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 议员签证在出发前一天才获签 美国延迟向执政党议员签发签证，引发朝野竞争党派之间关于这是否意味着韩美同盟摩擦日益加剧的争论。主要反对党国民力量党（PPP）称，这一事件明确表明同盟内部的信任正在削弱。PPP高级发言人朴成勋议员周六在一份声明中表示：“这是一个象征性时刻，清楚地暴露出韩美同盟之间日益扩大的裂痕，以及两国之间信任的彻底崩塌。”朴写道：“韩国议会国防委员会主席在最终获准入境美国之前，竟不得不向我们的盟友美国提交其过去因违反《国家安全法》而被定罪的英文翻译文件和无犯罪记录证明，这是前所未有的外交尴尬，也是国家的耻辱。”朴的声明发布前，执政的韩国民主党（DPK）议员、国会国防委员会主席金银峻宣布，他的签证直到委员会原定出发前往美国驻夏威夷太平洋司令部前一天才获签。金银峻周三表示，他收到了拒签通知并表达了遗憾，称此次出行并非私人访问，而是公务访问，旨在会见美国政府和军方官员。拒签的确切原因尚不清楚，但一些观察人士认为，这可能与该议员在20世纪80年代违反《国家安全法》的记录有关，这种情况在昔日支持民主的抗议人士中较为常见。金银峻是第二起类似案例，因为前DPK领导人郑清莱议员上月也曾遭遇签证延迟，最终不得不将议会考察行程改为前往欧洲。郑清莱曾参与20世纪80年代的反美活动。朴写道：“金银峻或许会像什么都没发生过一样登上飞往夏威夷的飞机，但这并不能消除当前同盟动荡不稳的状态。”DPK则反驳了有关说法，指责PPP是在将这一问题政治化，而非支持议会履职。DPK党鞭李珠希议员周六在一份声明中说：“当合法的议会活动受到阻碍时，PPP怎么能攻击自己的 fellow lawmaker？PPP无意维护国家利益。”她敦促PPP为将此事政治化而道歉。DPK发言人申铉英也表示，PPP“应避免作出损害韩美同盟的言论，也不要试图在首尔与华盛顿之间挑拨离间。”与此同时，美国国务卿马可·鲁比奥就签证问题暗示，这是一起基于过往行为的“个人”案件。鲁比奥周六（当地时间）在亚特兰大举行的二十国集团外长会议后举行的新闻发布会上对记者说：“我认为，当时确实有一个涉及个人行为的签证出了问题，可能是几十年前的事。但我们会在双边层面处理此事，而不是在新闻发布会上讨论。”此前，他曾会见韩国外交部长赵显；赵显上周赴美国前表示，他将与鲁比奥讨论此事

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary: Contract provides momentum for MASGA initiative Hanwha Group has won its first contract to build a warship for the United States Navy after its acquisition of Philadelphia-based Philly Shipyard in December 2024, marking a tangible step forward in the Korea-U.S. shipbuilding cooperation initiative known as Make American Shipbuilding Great Again (MASGA).
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: 合同为MASGA倡议注入动力 韩华集团继2024年12月收购总部位于费城的费城船厂后，首次获得为美国海军建造军舰的合同，标志着韩美造船合作倡议“让美国造船再次伟大”（MASGA）取得切实进展。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Contract provides momentum for MASGA initiative Hanwha Group has won its first contract to build a warship for the United States Navy after its acquisition of Philadelphia-based Philly Shipyard in December 2024, marking a tangible step forward in the Korea-U.S. shipbuilding cooperation initiative known as Make American Shipbuilding Great Again (MASGA). Hanwha Group said Sunday that Hanwha Defense USA has signed a $269 million (357.5 billion won) contract with TOTE Services to build a landing ship medium (LSM). TOTE Services is a vessel construction manager entrusted by the U.S. Navy with overseeing shipbuilding contracts and managing vessel construction. The construction of the LSM is expected to begin in the fourth quarter of next year, and the contract also includes options for three additional vessels. The LSM is an expeditionary landing vessel designed to support the U.S. Navy's operations in contested coastal areas, including the Indo-Pacific region. It is tasked with transporting and deploying Marine Corps personnel, equipment and supplies to coastal areas. The U.S. Navy aims to secure 35 LSMs. The vessel measures 100 meters in length and 16 meters in width, with a light displacement of approximately 2,687 tons and a cruising range of about 7,400 kilometers. The U.S. Navy’s LSM program is based on the LST-100 design developed by Dutch shipbuilder Damen. The Navy plans to accelerate the initial deployment of the vessels by using an existing commercial design and building them simultaneously at multiple shipyards. TOTE Services selected the shipbuilders through a competitive bidding process, evaluating their safety records, quality standards and track records for on-time delivery. Hanwha Philly Shipyard has maintained a longstanding partnership with TOTE Services, building and delivering four National Security Multi-Mission Vessels under the vessel construction manager model for the U.S. Maritime Administration. Hanwha Defense USA has also deployed personnel to Philadelphia since early this year to support the shipyard's preparations for U.S. Navy projects. Hanwha Group said the order bears significance as it demonstrates Hanwha Philly Shipyard's capabilities to build not only commercial vessels but also naval ships, laying a strategic foundation for expanding its business with the U.S. Navy. Hanwha Group acquired Philly Shipyard for $100 million in 2024 and announced plans in 2025 to invest $5 billion in upgrading the shipyard's infrastructure. In March, Hanwha Philly Shipyard and Hanwha Defense USA participated in the conceptual design of the U.S. Navy's Next Generation Logistics Ship. In July, the shipyard was also selected to build a Missile Range Instrumentation Vessel for the U.S. Golden Dome missile defense system. In September, Hanwha also established a new subsidiary, Hanwha Defense USA Shipbuilding, to operate Hanwha Philly Shipyard and strengthen the group’s shipbuilding and naval defense businesses in the U.S. With the latest order, Hanwha has expanded its involvement in U.S. Navy projects from ship design to construction. "Since acquiring Philly Shipyard in 2024, Hanwha has made substantial investments in personnel and technology to establish a shipbuilding base capable of serving federal government customers, including the U.S. Navy," Hanwha Defense USA CEO Michael Coulter said. "We will continue working with TOTE Services to ensure the vessel is delivered on schedule and within budget." The contract also carries significance as it marks a tangible achievement in warship construction just 15 months after Seoul proposed the MASGA initiative. Under the initiative, Korea agreed to commit $150 billion to bilateral shipbuilding cooperation to help rebuild the U.S. shipbuilding industry and strengthen its naval shipbuilding capabilities. Last year, the U.S. announced plans to procure 364 new vessels by 2054, comprising 293 combat ships and 71 logistics and support vessels, as it seeks to strengthen its naval capability amid intensifying competition with China. Against this backdrop, industry officials said the latest contract served as a stepping stone to provide further momentum for future projects with Korean shipbuilders. U.S. Senator Dave McCormick highlighted Hanwha's planned $5 billion investment in Philadelphia as an example of how cooperation with close U.S. allies can help rebuild America's shipbuilding capacity and strengthen its defense industrial base. “Pennsylvania is leading the way as we rebuild American shipbuilding, bringing jobs, manufacturing and opportunity back to our state,” McCormick said. “Hanwha’s continued commitment to Philadelphia shows what is possible when we invest in American workers and American industry.”
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: 韩华获得美国海军首个造船订单
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: 合同为MASGA倡议注入动力：韩华集团继2024年12月收购总部位于费城的Philly Shipyard后，首次获得美国海军舰船建造合同，标志着韩美造船合作倡议“让美国造船业再次伟大”（MASGA）取得实质性进展。韩华集团周日表示，旗下韩华防务美国公司与TOTE Services签署了一份价值2.69亿美元（3575亿韩元）的合同，将建造一艘中型登陆舰（LSM）。TOTE Services是美国海军委托的船舶建造管理公司，负责监督造船合同并管理舰船建造。该登陆舰预计于明年第四季度开工，合同还包含增建3艘舰船的选择权。LSM是一种远征登陆舰，旨在支持美国海军在争议沿海地区，包括印太地区的行动，负责将海军陆战队人员、装备和物资运送并部署至沿海地区。美国海军计划部署35艘LSM。该舰长100米、宽16米，轻载排水量约2687吨，巡航里程约7400公里。美国海军的LSM项目以荷兰造船商Damen开发的LST-100设计为基础。海军计划利用现有商业设计加速舰船的初始部署，并在多家船厂同时建造。TOTE Services通过竞争性招标程序选择造船商，评估其安全记录、质量标准以及按期交付的业绩。韩华Philly Shipyard与TOTE Services保持着长期合作关系，按照船舶建造管理模式，为美国海事管理局建造并交付了4艘国家安全多任务舰。韩华防务美国公司今年早些时候还向费城派驻人员，支持船厂为美国海军项目做准备。韩华集团表示，这份订单具有重要意义，因为它证明韩华Philly Shipyard不仅能够建造商用舰船，也具备建造军用舰船的能力，为扩大与美国海军的业务往来奠定了战略基础。韩华集团于2024年以1亿美元收购Philly Shipyard，并于2025年宣布计划投资50亿美元升级船厂基础设施。今年3月，韩华Philly Shipyard和韩华防务美国公司参与了美国海军“下一代后勤舰”的概念设计。7月，该船厂还入选为美国“金穹”导弹防御系统建造导弹靶场测量舰。9月，韩华还成立了新子公司韩华防务美国造船公司，负责运营韩华Philly Shipyard，并强化该集团在美国的造船和海防业务。随着最新订单的落地，韩华已将对美国海军项目的参与范围从舰船设计扩大至建造。韩华防务美国公司首席执行官Michael Coulter表示：“自2024年收购Philly Shipyard以来，韩华在人员和技术方面投入了大量资源，建立了能够服务包括美国海军在内的联邦政府客户的造船基地。我们将继续与TOTE Services合作，确保舰船按期并在预算范围内交付。”这份合同还具有重要意义，因为就在首尔提出MASGA倡议仅15个月后，舰船建造便取得了实质性成果。根据该倡议，韩国同意承诺投入1500亿美元开展双边造船合作，以帮助重建美国造船业并增强其军用舰船建造能力。去年，美国宣布计划到2054年前采购364艘新舰船，其中包括293艘作战舰和71艘后勤及支援舰，以应对与中国日益加剧的竞争并增强海军能力。在这一背景下，业内人士表示，最新合同为韩国造船商承接未来项目进一步注入动力提供了垫脚石。美国参议员Dave McCormick强调，韩华计划在费城投资50亿美元，证明了与美国这一密切盟友合作有助于重建美国造船能力、强化国防工业基础。McCormick说：“在我们重建美国造船业的过程中，宾夕法尼亚州正发挥带头作用，把就业、制造业和机遇带回本州。韩华对费城的持续投入表明，对美国工人和美国工业进行投资能够带来何种可能。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/edi.summary: President Lee Jae Myung’s anti-diversity rhetoric is doing more harm than good. His remarks about the role of migrant workers in the Korean economy at Tuesday’s Cabinet meeting sparked controversy. In a series of social media posts beginning Wednesday, he called for a reassessment of policies for multicultural families.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/edi.summary_zh: 总统李在明的反多样性言论弊大于利。他周二内阁会议上关于移民劳工在韩国经济中所发挥作用的讲话引发争议。从周三开始，他连续发布社交媒体帖子，呼吁重新评估针对多元文化家庭的政策。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/edi.body: President Lee Jae Myung’s anti-diversity rhetoric is doing more harm than good. His remarks about the role of migrant workers in the Korean economy at Tuesday’s Cabinet meeting sparked controversy. But he did not stop there. Instead, he poured fuel on the fire. In a series of social media posts beginning Wednesday, he called for a reassessment of policies for multicultural families. His remarks have backfired. The president has become a source of concern among members of his own ruling Democratic Party of Korea (DPK). Few have voiced their concerns publicly, but many DPK lawmakers reportedly believe Lee has gone too far and that someone needs to sound the alarm. Politicians are supposed to bring people together, not divide them. Lee, however, has done the opposite. His anti-diversity rhetoric has undermined his own political standing. Even some of his traditional support groups — particularly progressives — have begun criticizing him. Labor unions have characterized Lee’s remarks as hate speech. The Korean Federation of Trade Unions accused him of treating migrant workers like an ATM, arguing that his comments fuel hostility toward them. The criticism followed media reports about Lee’s remarks at Tuesday’s Cabinet meeting. During the livestreamed meeting, Lee questioned the economic contributions of foreign workers, arguing that they send their earnings back to their home countries. Lee subsequently expressed dissatisfaction with media coverage of his comments. Sharing an article from a left-leaning newspaper on social media, he complained that his remarks had been taken out of context. He openly demanded that the newspaper revise its headline to better reflect his intentions and apologize to him. The outlet changed the headline as he requested, but that apparently was not enough. Lee continued to demand a public apology on social media. The president's response was excessive. The newspaper's correction was an acknowledgment that its original headline had been problematic. Most politicians would have accepted such a correction and moved on. Lee's continued demand for a public apology gives the impression that he was seeking to pressure and publicly embarrass the newspaper rather than settle the dispute. On Wednesday, Lee wrote that preferential policies based on ethnicity should be reviewed. "While it is true that support for multicultural families is necessary, that cannot justify specific policies that are unreasonable or may result in reverse discrimination," he said. On Friday, he called for a level playing field, arguing that some multicultural support measures were unfair. He challenged the assumption that all multicultural families belong to the working class, pointing out that some include children of highly skilled, white-collar foreign workers and their Korean spouses. Such families, he argued, should not automatically be classified as marginalized households. He also called for equal treatment of disadvantaged multicultural families and low-income Korean households. "If there are poor multicultural families, they should be entitled to policy support available to poor Korean households," he wrote, suggesting that government assistance should not be determined by ethnicity but by economic circumstances. Diversity-related spending should not be confused with preferential treatment or a double standard. Tailored policies for multicultural families are necessary to help them integrate into Korean society. Depending on their circumstances, additional public spending on ethnically diverse families is inevitable. According to the Ministry of Data and Statistics, Korea had 451,492 multicultural households in 2025. Their number has continued to increase year after year. More than 70 percent consist of Korean husbands and foreign wives. Vietnam accounts for the largest share of foreign spouses at 30 percent, followed by China at 12.2 percent and Thailand at 5.4 percent. These demographic characteristics underscore the need for targeted policy support. Foreign spouses and their children often need assistance overcoming language barriers and adapting to Korean society. Other social and cultural services are also necessary to help migrant spouses and their children settle into their communities. Such support is not a waste of taxpayer money. It is an investment in the nation's future. Diversity has become an irreversible trend. In 2025, foreign-born residents accounted for 5.24 percent of Korea's population. Their numbers have risen steadily over the past several decades, outpacing earlier projections. As the foreign-born population grows, greater public spending on social integration, education and cultural services will inevitably be required. This should not be viewed as an unfair privilege granted to certain groups. Rather, it is a necessary response to the country's changing demographics. Lee should be promoting social cohesion, not fueling resentment toward minorities. His rhetoric risks undermining the very values of inclusion and solidarity that progressives have traditionally championed
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/edi.title_zh: Ed对平权行动持疑点的看法遭批驳
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/edi.body_zh: 李在明总统的反多样性言论弊大于利。他周二在内阁会议上就外籍劳工作在韩国经济中的作用发表的言论引发争议，但他并未就此收手，反而火上浇油。周三起，他通过一系列社交媒体帖子，呼吁重新审视针对多元文化家庭的政策。他的言论适得其反。总统本人已成为执政的朝鲜民主主义党（DPK）党员忧虑的对象。公开表达担忧者寥寥，但据报道，许多DPK议员认为李在明做得过头，必须有人发出警报。政治人物本应凝聚民众，而非分化民众，李在明却适得其反。他的反多样性言论削弱了自己的政治根基，就连他的一些传统支持群体，尤其是进步派，也开始批评他。工会将李在明的言论定性为仇恨言论。韩国工会联合会指责他把外籍劳工当成取款机，认为其言论煽动针对外籍劳工的敌意。此前，媒体报道了李在明周二内阁会议上的言论。在网络直播的会议上，李在明质疑外籍劳工对经济的贡献，称他们会把自己的收入汇回祖国。此后，李在明对媒体如何报道其言论表示不满。他在社交媒体上分享了一篇左翼报纸的文章，抱怨媒体断章取义，并公开要求该报修改标题，以更好地体现他的本意，同时向他道歉。该媒体按照他的要求修改了标题，但这显然仍不够。李在明继续在社交媒体上要求对方公开道歉。总统的回应过度了。报纸更正标题，等于承认原标题存在问题，多数政治人物都会接受这种更正并继续处理。李在明仍不断要求公开道歉，给人留下的印象是，他是在施压并公开羞辱该报，而不是理性解决分歧。周三，李在明写道，基于族裔的优惠政策应当重新审查。他说：“支持多元文化家庭固然必要，但这不能成为推行不合理政策或可能造成反向歧视的特定政策的理由。”周五，他呼吁实现公平竞争，认为一些针对多元文化群体的扶持措施不公平。他质疑所有多元文化家庭都属于工人阶级的预设，指出其中一些家庭包括高技能外籍劳工及其韩国配偶的孩子。他认为，此类家庭不应被自动归类为边缘化家庭。他还呼吁，对处于不利地位的多元文化家庭和低收入韩国家庭实行平等待遇。他写道：“如果存在贫困的多元文化家庭，他们应当享有面向贫困韩国家庭提供的政策支持。”这表明，政府援助不应依据族裔，而应依据经济状况。与多样性有关的支出不应与优待或双重标准混为一谈。针对多元文化家庭量身定制的政策十分必要，可以帮助他们融入韩国社会。根据各自处境，额外增加对不同族裔家庭的公共支出不可避免。据数据与统计部称，2025年韩国有451,492个多元文化家庭，数量仍在逐年增加，其中超过70%由韩国丈夫和外国妻子组成。外国配偶中，越南占比最高，为30%，其次是中国，为12.2%，泰国为5.4%。这些人口结构特征凸显了实施针对性政策支持的必要性。外国配偶及其子女往往需要帮助克服语言障碍、适应韩国社会。为帮助外籍配偶及其子女融入所在社区，也需要提供其他社会和文化服务。这类支持并非浪费纳税人资金，而是对国家未来的投资。多样性已成为不可逆转的趋势。2025年，外国出生居民占韩国人口的5.24%。过去几十年来，这一群体规模持续增长，并超出此前的预测。随着外国出生人口增加，社会融合、教育和文化服务方面必然需要投入更多公共资金。这不应被视为给予某些群体的不公平特权，而应被视为应对国家人口结构变化的必要举措。李在明应当促进社会凝聚力，而不是煽动针对少数群体的怨恨。他的言论可能损害进步派历来倡导的包容与团结价值观。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.summary: South Korea's exports jumped 93.7 percent to a record $115.3 billion in October from a year earlier, driven largely by a sharp increase in semiconductor shipments, data showed Sunday. Strong global demand for semiconductors, coupled with continued investments by major technology companies in artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure, boosted overall exports, the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Resources said in a press release.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.summary_zh: 数据显示，韩国10月出口额同比增长93.7%，创1153亿美元的历史纪录，主要得益于半导体出货量大幅增加。韩国贸易、工业和资源部在一份新闻稿中表示，全球对半导体的强劲需求，以及主要科技公司持续投资人工智能基础设施，推动了整体出口增长。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body: South Korea's exports jumped 93.7 percent to a record $115.3 billion in October from a year earlier, driven largely by a sharp increase in semiconductor shipments, data showed Sunday. Strong global demand for semiconductors, coupled with continued investments by major technology companies in artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure, boosted overall exports, the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Resources said in a press release. Imports rose 36 percent from a year earlier to $72.78 billion, resulting in a trade surplus of $42.5 billion. Cumulative exports for the January-October period exceeded $900 billion for the first time, with the ministry projecting that the country's annual exports could reach $1 trillion as early as November if the current trend continues. By sector, semiconductor exports, a key pillar of Asia's fourth-largest economy, skyrocketed 259 percent from a year earlier to $56.4 billion in October, the release said. Exports of petroleum products jumped 80 percent to $6.92 billion, while those of petrochemical products rose 27.5 percent to $4 billion. Cosmetics exports shot up 57.5 percent to $1.44 billion on rising demand in China, the United States and the European Union. Automobile exports gained 18.1 percent to $6.55 billion, driven by increased overseas demand for gasoline hybrid models. By destination, exports to China soared 133.6 percent to $26.98 billion, driven by strong shipments of semiconductors and wireless communications equipment. Exports to China topped $20 billion for the fifth consecutive month. Shipments to the United States surged 185.8 percent to $24.9 billion, supported by robust demand for semiconductors, computers and electrical equipment used in AI infrastructure. The monthly report also showed exports to Southeast Asian countries rose 128 percent to $21.33 billion, while those to the European Union increased 56.4 percent to $8.1 billion, with both gains driven by strong shipments of chips and automobiles. "The global trade environment remains uncertain, with many small and medium-sized enterprises facing difficulties amid rising protectionism in major economies, shifts in global supply chains and geopolitical tensions in the Middle East," Industry Minister Kim Jung-kwan said. To address these challenges, the government will step up trade cooperation with major export partners and work to remove barriers to exports to ease the burden on businesses, he said
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.title_zh: 芯片销售强劲，韩国10月出口额达到1153亿美元
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body_zh: 韩国10月出口额同比增长93.7%，创纪录的1153亿美元，主要得益于半导体出货量大幅增加。数据显示，韩国工业贸易资源部在一份新闻稿中表示，全球对半导体的旺盛需求，加上主要科技公司持续投资人工智能基础设施，推动了整体出口增长。进口额同比增长36%，达到727.8亿美元，实现贸易顺差425亿美元。1月至10月累计出口额首次突破900亿美元；该部预计，如果当前趋势持续，韩国全年出口额最早可于11月达到1万亿美元。新闻稿称，作为亚洲第四大经济体的支柱行业，半导体出口额10月同比飙升259%，达到564亿美元。石油产品出口额增长80%，达到69.2亿美元；石化产品出口额增长27.5%，达到40亿美元。受中国、美国和欧盟需求上升推动，化妆品出口额猛增57.5%，达到14.4亿美元。混合动力汽车海外需求增加，推动汽车出口额增长18.1%，达到65.5亿美元。按目的地划分，受半导体和无线通信设备出货量强劲推动，对华出口额飙升133.6%，达到269.8亿美元，对华出口额连续第5个月超过200亿美元。得益于半导体、计算机以及人工智能基础设施所用电气设备的旺盛需求，对美出货额激增185.8%，达到249亿美元。月报还显示，对东南亚国家出口额增长128%，达到213.3亿美元；对欧盟出口额增长56.4%，达到81亿美元，两项增长均得益于芯片和汽车出货量强劲。产业部长金正官表示：“全球贸易环境仍不确定，主要经济体保护主义抬头、全球供应链调整以及中东地缘政治紧张，使许多中小企业面临困难。”他说，为应对这些挑战，政府将加强与主要出口伙伴的贸易合作，并努力消除出口壁垒，以减轻企业负担。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.summary_zh: 韩国交易所点名“低市净率”公司，力图应对“韩国折价” 韩华生命保险、现代钢铁和乐天购物位列韩国交易所公开点名的151家公司之中，这些公司的估值长期偏低。多家市值超过1万亿韩元（7.5亿美元）的公司也上了名单，包括现代钢铁、_emart_、乐天购物和乐天化学。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body: Korea Exchange names 'low-PBR' companies in push to tackle 'Korea discount' Hanwha Life Insurance, Hyundai Steel and Lotte Shopping are among 151 companies publicly flagged by the Korea Exchange for their persistently low valuations. The bourse operator revealed the list Sunday in an unprecedented move aimed at pushing listed firms to improve their corporate value. The initiative targets companies that have consistently traded at low price-to-book ratios (PBRs) while doing little to return capital to shareholders. Whether the public disclosure will spur them to take concrete steps to boost their valuations and help narrow the so-called "Korea discount" remains to be seen. The list comprises 96 KOSPI-listed companies and 55 on the Kosdaq that ranked in the bottom 25 percent and 10 percent, respectively, of their markets in terms of PBR over the past three years. PBR measures a company's market capitalization relative to its net assets, showing how much investors are willing to pay for each unit of book value. A ratio below 1 means the company is valued at less than its net assets, potentially reflecting concerns about its growth prospects or how efficiently it deploys capital. Several companies with market capitalizations exceeding 1 trillion won ($750 million) made the list, including Hyundai Steel, Emart, Lotte Shopping and Lotte Chemical. Four financial firms were also included: Hanwha Life, with a market capitalization of more than 3.5 trillion won, the largest among the designated companies, as well as DB Securities, Hyundai Motor Securities and Heungkuk Fire & Marine Insurance. The names will be available on the Korea Exchange's stock market disclosure and information portal from Monday through May 4, 2027, and will carry a “low PBR” tag on securities firms' trading platforms. The exchange plans to update the list every May and November. Beginning next year, it will also provide one-on-one consulting for selected firms to help them identify the causes of their low valuations and establish targets and plans for improvement. The disclosure puts listed firms' corporate value-up initiatives under closer scrutiny, raising expectations that they will move beyond mere pledges and demonstrate tangible results. Ultimately, a lasting revaluation will require stronger profitability, more efficient capital allocation and greater shareholder returns. “Even companies that have been reluctant to return capital to shareholders may feel compelled to reconsider their approach once they appear on the low-PBR list,” said Na Jeong-hwan, a strategist at NH Investment & Securities. “Investors should watch for those that respond to the disclosure by stepping up their corporate value-up announcements.”
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.title_zh: 韩华生命、现代钢铁、乐天购物等151家公司因估值长期偏低而受到关注
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body_zh: 韩国交易所列出“低市净率”公司，推动解决“韩国折价”问题。Hanwha Life Insurance、现代钢铁和乐天购物位列韩国交易所公开点名的151家公司之中，原因是这些公司的估值长期偏低。该交易所周日公布了这一名单，这是前所未有的举措，旨在推动上市公司改善企业价值。该计划针对的是那些市净率持续偏低、且很少向股东返还资本的公司。此次公开披露能否促使这些公司采取具体措施提升估值，并帮助缩小所谓的“韩国折价”，仍有待观察。名单包括96家在KOSPI上市的公司和55家在Kosdaq上市的公司；过去3年，这些公司的市净率分别处于各自市场后25%和后10%的区间。市净率衡量公司市值相对于净资产的比率，显示投资者愿意为每一单位账面价值支付多少。低于1的比率意味着公司估值低于净资产，可能反映出市场对其增长前景或资本运用效率的担忧。名单中有多家公司市值超过1万亿韩元（7.5亿美元），包括现代钢铁、Emart、乐天购物和乐天化学。名单还纳入4家金融企业：市值超过3.5万亿韩元、在被指定公司中最高的Hanwha Life，以及DB Securities、现代汽车证券和兴国火灾海上保险。从周一开始至2027年5月4日，这些公司名称将在韩国交易所的股市披露及信息门户网站上公布，并会在证券公司的交易平台上标注“低市净率”标签。交易所计划每年5月和11月更新名单。从明年开始，交易所还将为选定公司提供一对一咨询，帮助它们找出估值偏低的原因，并制定改善目标和计划。此次披露将使上市公司的企业价值提升举措受到更密切的监督，人们期待这些公司不再仅仅作出承诺，而是展示切实成果。归根结底，实现持久的价值重估需要更强的盈利能力、更有效的资本配置以及更高的股东回报。NH Investment & Securities策略师Na Jeong-hwan表示：“即使是不愿向股东返还资本的公司，一旦进入低市净率名单，也可能不得不重新考虑其做法。投资者应关注哪些公司会通过加大企业价值提升公告力度来回应此次披露。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary: North Korea’s recent economic growth in the 3 percent range was a “temporary war windfall” from the Russia-Ukraine war that would potentially lead to reduced domestic consumption, according to an analysis released by a think tank run by South Korea's spy agency on Sunday. “North Korea’s recent economic growth has been heavily driven by a unilateral surge in heavy industry and construction … Those facilities and manufactured munitions yield almost no tangible benefit for public livelihood,” he added.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary_zh: 韩国情报机构下属智库于星期日发布的一项分析称，朝鲜近期约3%的经济增长是俄乌战争带来的“短暂战争红利”，可能导致国内消费下降。分析称：“朝鲜近期经济增长在很大程度上受到重工业和建筑业单边扩张的推动……这些设施和制造的军需品几乎无法为民众生计带来任何实际利益。”他还补充说。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: North Korea’s recent economic growth in the 3 percent range was a “temporary war windfall” from the Russia-Ukraine war that would potentially lead to reduced domestic consumption, according to an analysis released by a think tank run by South Korea's spy agency on Sunday. “North Korea’s recent economic growth has been heavily driven by a unilateral surge in heavy industry and construction … Those facilities and manufactured munitions yield almost no tangible benefit for public livelihood,” he added. Citing Bank of Korea estimates , showing North Korea’s real gross domestic product grew by 3.5 percent in 2025, following growth of 3.1 percent in 2023 and 3.7 percent in 2024, marking three consecutive years of growth in the 3 percent range, the report said the growth range is lower than other developing countries given the size of arms exports to Russia that began in the second half of 2023 and the growth heavily focused in specific sectors such as munitions and construction. Until 2022, Pyongyang continued to record negative economic growth for the last consecutive years. “Pyongyang’s 3 percent range growth and domestic sector growth depend heavily on the Russia-Ukraine war. If Russia stops ordering the armories and reciprocal aid stops, North Korea’s arms plants and factories will become immediately useless.” The analysis estimated the accumulated economic value of North Korea’s arms exports to Russia since August 2023 and troop deployments since October 2024 at approximately $11 billion (14.67 trillion won) as of late last year. If the scale of arms exports and troop deployments keeps at last year’s levels, the cumulative economic value is projected to reach around $16 billion by the end of this year. The analysis also noted that prices of certain goods in North Korea’s private markets, known as jangmadang, rose by triple-digit percentages. “Between the first quarter of 2024 and the third quarter of 2026, the North Korean won plummeted against major foreign currencies, with exchange rates for the U.S. dollar and Chinese yuan surging by 646.5 percent and 697.2 percent, respectively. Over the same period, market prices for essential commodities skyrocketed: rice rose by 599.4 percent, corn by 447 percent, pork by 368.3 percent, gasoline by 527 percent and diesel by 669.8 percent.”
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: 研究称，受俄乌战争影响，朝鲜经济增长只是“暂时的”
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 韩国情报机构运营的一家智库于周日发布的一项分析称，朝鲜近期约3%的经济增长是俄乌战争带来的“临时性战争红利”，这可能导致国内消费下降。分析称：“朝鲜近期的经济增长在很大程度上受到重工业和建筑业单边扩张的推动……这些设施和制式军品对改善民生几乎没有任何实际益处。”报告援引韩国央行估算称，朝鲜实际国内生产总值在2025年增长3.5%，继2023年增长3.1%和2024年增长3.7%后，连续三年保持在3%左右的增长区间。鉴于朝鲜自2023年下半年开始向俄罗斯出口军品，且经济增长高度集中于军品和建筑等特定行业，其增幅低于其他发展中国家。直到2022年，平壤此前已连续多年录得经济负增长。分析称：“平壤约3%的经济增长以及国内各行业的增长在很大程度上依赖俄乌战争。如果俄罗斯停止订购武器、相互援助也停止，朝鲜的军工厂和工厂将立即失去用途。”分析估算，截至去年底，朝鲜自2023年8月以来对俄罗斯的军品出口以及自2024年10月以来的派兵行动，累计经济价值约为110亿美元（14.67万亿韩元）。如果军品出口和派兵规模维持在去年的水平，到今年年底，累计经济价值预计将达到约160亿美元。分析还指出，朝鲜被称为“ Jangmadang ”的私人市场中某些商品的价格上涨了三位数百分比。报告称：“从2024年第一季度到2026年第三季度，朝鲜元兑主要外币大幅贬值，美元和人民币汇率分别飙升646.5%和697.2%。同期，必需商品的市场价格暴涨：大米上涨599.4%，玉米上涨447%，猪肉上涨368.3%，汽油上涨527%，柴油上涨669.8%。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary: heist in Binance likely to fund Pyongyang's military ambitions The $6.36 billion cryptocurrency heist targeting Binance has exposed a troubling reality for the digital asset industry: North Korea is increasingly exploiting security vulnerabilities to bankroll Pyongyang's military ambitions. The stolen amount is equivalent to 22 percent of North Korea's 2025 gross domestic product, making the attack the largest cryptocurrency theft on record and one of the biggest financial crimes in history.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary_zh: 针对币安的大型劫案可能为平壤的军事野心提供资金。盗窃币安加密货币的案件涉及63.6亿美元，暴露出数字资产行业面临的一个令人不安的现实：朝鲜正日益利用安全漏洞，为平壤的军事野心筹集资金。被盗金额相当于朝鲜2025年国内生产总值的22%，使这次袭击成为有记录以来规模最大的加密货币盗窃案，也是历史上最大的金融犯罪之一。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: Latest $6.3 bil. heist in Binance likely to fund Pyongyang's military ambitions The $6.36 billion cryptocurrency heist targeting Binance has exposed a troubling reality for the digital asset industry: North Korea is increasingly exploiting security vulnerabilities to bankroll Pyongyang's military ambitions. The stolen amount is equivalent to 22 percent of North Korea's 2025 gross domestic product, making the attack the largest cryptocurrency theft on record and one of the biggest financial crimes in history. "We're dealing with sophisticated adversaries who may have substantial resources, years of patience and objectives that extend well beyond financial gain," said Michael O'Loughlin, managing partner of Argonautic Global and board member of Blockchain Ireland. Proceeds from cryptocurrency theft have become an increasingly important source of funding for cash-strapped North Korea, alongside an estimated $22 billion in foreign income generated since 2022 through its support for Russia's war in Ukraine. The stolen funds could help finance its nuclear and ballistic missile programs, as well as efforts to modernize its conventional forces. Even if roughly half of the stolen assets are ultimately recovered, Pyongyang could still walk away with billions of dollars in additional funding, according to Adam Farrar, senior geoeconomics analyst for Asia-Pacific at Bloomberg Economics. These financial resources, combined with deepening ties with Moscow and renewed outreach from Beijing, also leave North Korean leader Kim Jong-un with fewer incentives to compromise on his nuclear program, he added. "Pyongyang has every incentive to keep exploiting gaps in the crypto ecosystem to finance its military ambitions," Farrar said. "The Binance hack will certainly not be the last." Suspected North Korea-linked cyberattacks account for nearly 89 percent of reported losses in cryptocurrency heists so far this year, compared with just 15 percent in 2021, according to blockchain intelligence firm Chainalysis. The average loss per suspected North Korea-linked cyberattack has nearly quadrupled, from $50.65 million in 2021 to $185.65 million this year. The U.S. FBI and blockchain intelligence firms identified the figures of the Binance attack as TraderTraitor, an elite North Korean hacking group. The FBI also attributed the $1.5 billion Bybit heist in February 2025 to the same group. U.S. President Donald Trump commented on the crypto heist on Saturday. "We're learning about it. We don't know if it's North Korea, but if it is, we'll talk to them about it," he told Fox Business. North Korea has reportedly developed a systematic training program to cultivate a new generation of cyber operatives. Students who show an early aptitude for mathematics and science are selected for specialized cyberwarfare training lasting three to five years, with top performers advancing to elite university programs. Industry officials warn that advances in artificial intelligence (AI) could make future attacks easier to carry out. "What has changed is the sophistication of the attacks themselves. TRM analysts have begun to speculate that North Korean operators are incorporating AI tools ... which required weeks of targeted manipulation of complex blockchain mechanisms," blockchain intelligence firm TRM Labs wrote in April. The Binance heist could make a growing number of traditional companies more wary of adopting blockchain technology, according to analysts, as the industry seeks to expand its role in conventional financial markets. "These attacks damage public confidence because people don't distinguish between a failure of the technology and a failure of the institution protecting their money — nor should we expect them to," O'Loughlin said. "North Korea's cyber operations demonstrate something important: You don't necessarily need to defeat a financial system to steal from it. Sometimes you only need to compromise one person with the right access. That's why cybersecurity cannot be treated as a technology problem alone. It's a question of people, governance and institutional resilience." Korea is working on a comprehensive regulatory framework for digital assets, known as the Digital Asset Basic Act. The country has also been grappling with a string of cyberattacks targeting major companies, including Bithumb, its second-largest cryptocurrency exchange. As cyberthreats grow more sophisticated, analysts say safeguarding the financial system will require not only stronger technological defenses but also closer cooperation among governments, financial institutions and technology providers. "These cyberattacks are not just a 'crypto' problem; these are a global financial markets and security problem, affecting nearly all of us," said Sandra Ro, CEO of the Global Blockchain Business Council. The recent Binance attack prompted the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange to suspend withdrawals and pledge to cover all losses. Binance said Saturday that it had replaced about 90 percent of the stolen amount using its own funds and planned to restore withdrawals by Sunday

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh:
针对 Binance 的最新 63亿美元劫案或将为平壤的军事野心提供资金
这起针对 Binance、价值63.6亿美元的加密货币劫案暴露出数字资产行业一个令人不安的现实：朝鲜正日益利用安全漏洞，为平壤的军事野心筹措资金。被盗金额相当于朝鲜2025年国内生产总值的22%，使此次袭击成为有记录以来规模最大的加密货币盗窃案，也是历史上最大的金融犯罪之一。Argonautic Global 管理合伙人、Blockchain Ireland 董事会成员 Michael O'Loughlin 表示：“我们面对的是手段高明的对手，他们可能拥有大量资源、数年的耐心，以及远超经济收益的目标。”
自2022年以来，朝鲜通过支持俄罗斯对乌克兰的战争，估计获得了220亿美元海外收入；与此同时，加密货币盗窃所得也已成为这个资金拮据国家日益重要的资金来源。被盗资金可能用于资助其核计划和弹道导弹项目，以及推动常规部队现代化。据 Bloomberg Economics 亚太地区高级地缘经济学分析师 Adam Farrar 表示，即使最终追回约一半被盗资产，平壤仍可能额外获得数十亿美元资金。他还指出，这些金融资源，加上朝鲜与莫斯科关系日益密切以及北京重新开展外交接触，也让朝鲜领导人 Kim Jong-un 更缺乏在核计划上作出妥协的动机。Farrar 说：“平壤完全有动机继续利用加密货币生态中的缺口，为其军事野心提供资金。Binance 遭黑客攻击肯定不会成为最后一例。”
据区块链情报公司 Chainalysis 数据，迄今今年已报告的加密货币劫案损失中，近89%与疑似朝鲜有关联的网络攻击造成，而2021年这一比例仅为15%。每起疑似与朝鲜有关联的网络攻击造成的平均损失已接近此前的4倍，从2021年的5065万美元升至今年的1.8565亿美元。美国联邦调查局和区块链情报机构确认，针对 Binance 的此次攻击由朝鲜精英黑客组织 TraderTraitor 实施。联邦调查局还将2025年2月发生的15亿美元 Bybit 劫案也归咎于该组织。美国总统 Donald Trump 周六就这起加密货币劫案发表评论。他告诉 Fox Business：“我们正在了解情况。我们不知道是不是朝鲜干的，但如果是，我们会和他们谈谈。”
据报道，朝鲜已建立系统性培训项目，培养新一代网络行动人员。数学和科学方面较早表现出天赋的学生会被挑选参加专业网络战培训，培训持续三至五年，表现最优异者将进入顶尖大学项目。行业官员警告，人工智能的发展可能使未来攻击更容易实施。区块链情报公司 TRM Labs 4月写道：“发生变化的是攻击本身的复杂程度。TRM 分析师已开始推测，朝鲜行动人员正在利用人工智能工具……而这需要对复杂的区块链机制进行数周的针对性操控。”
分析人士表示，随着该行业寻求扩大自身在传统金融市场中的作用，Binance 劫案可能使越来越多的传统企业对接入区块链技术更加谨慎。O'Loughlin 说：“这些攻击损害公众信心，因为人们分不清技术失灵与保护其资金的机构失职；我们也不应期待他们能够分清。朝鲜的网络行动证明了一个重要事实：要从金融系统中窃取资金，并不一定要击败这个系统。有时只需控制一名拥有适当访问权限的人即可。因此，网络安全不能仅仅被视为技术问题。它还关乎人员、治理和机构韧性。”
韩国正在制定一套名为《数字资产基本法》的综合性数字资产监管框架。该国还一直在应对一连串针对大型企业的网络攻击，其中包括其第二大加密货币交易所 Bithumb。分析人士称，随着网络威胁日益复杂，保护金融系统不仅需要更强的技术防御，还需要政府、金融机构和技术提供商之间更紧密的合作。全球区块链商业委员会首席执行官 Sandra Ro 表示：“这些网络攻击不只是‘加密货币’问题；它们是全球金融市场和安全问题，几乎影响到我们所有人。”
最近的 Binance 袭击促使这家全球最大的加密货币交易所暂停提款，并承诺承担全部损失。Binance 周六表示，已使用自有资金补偿约90%的被盗金额，并计划在周日恢复提款

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title: CJ Olive Young expands Olive Better wellness chain to 5 locations
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary: CJ Olive Young has expanded its Olive Better wellness retail platform to five locations, adding branches tailored to office workers and tourists as it seeks to make wellness products part of consumers’ everyday routines. Olive Young said the expansion also provides growth opportunities for small and midsize beauty and wellness brands.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: CJ Olive Young已将其Olive Better健康零售平台扩展到五个地点，新增了针对上班族和游客的分店，以寻求让健康产品成为消费者日常习惯的一部分。Olive Young表示，此次扩张也为中小型美容和健康品牌提供了增长机会。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: CJ Olive Young has expanded its Olive Better wellness retail platform to five locations, adding branches tailored to office workers and tourists as it seeks to make wellness products part of consumers’ everyday routines. The expansion comes nine months after the first store opened in Seoul’s Gwanghwamun area in January. The company added stores at Starfield Coex Mall in southern Seoul and in Seongsu in eastern Seoul both last month, adapting product selections and experiences to each neighborhood’s customers. The Coex store focuses on “office wellness,” targeting workers seeking convenient ways to maintain healthy habits during busy schedules. Healthy snacks and protein products occupy the front of the store, helping shoppers quickly find items suited to their needs. A Daily Routine Bar offers products for individual purchase, allowing customers to try wellness items during commutes or lunch breaks. The Seongsu store, which opened Friday, is the chain’s largest and emphasizes experiences for trend-conscious shoppers and foreign tourists. It includes Better Bar, a food and beverage service offering wellness drinks, alongside a Sweets Library featuring low-sugar and vegan snacks. A sauna-themed section focuses on relaxation, while an In & Out Beauty zone connects beauty supplements, skin care and beauty devices. Olive Young said the expansion also provides growth opportunities for small and midsize beauty and wellness brands. It plans to continue identifying promising brands through its retail infrastructure and product curation capabilities, with the aim of developing Olive Better into a showcase for Korean wellness culture. “Drawing on the wellness curation expertise we have accumulated, we are continuing to develop Olive Better so wellness can become a natural part of customers’ daily lives,” a company official said. “We will continue expanding our physical locations to create more opportunities for everyone to easily enjoy a wellness lifestyle.”
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: CJ Olive Young将Olive Better健康养生连锁店扩展至5个地点
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: CJ Olive Young将其Olive Better健康养生零售平台扩展至5家门店，新增加的门店针对办公室职员和游客进行设计，目标是让养生产品成为消费者日常生活的一部分。距离首家门店于1月在首尔广华门区开业仅9个月，公司便启动了扩张。上个月，公司分别在首尔南部的Starfield Coex Mall和首尔东部的圣水新增门店，并根据各街区消费者的特点调整商品选择和购物体验。Coex门店主打“办公室养生”，面向希望在忙碌日程中寻找便捷方式以保持健康习惯的上班族。健康零食和蛋白质产品陈列在门店前部，帮助顾客快速找到适合自身需求的产品。Daily Routine Bar提供可单独购买的商品，让顾客能在通勤或午休期间体验养生产品。圣水门店于上周五开业，是该连锁规模最大的门店，重点面向注重潮流的消费者和外国游客提供体验。店内设有Better Bar，提供健康饮品等餐饮服务；还设有Sweets Library，主推低糖和纯素零食。桑拿主题区域主打放松，In & Out Beauty区域则将美容补充剂、护肤产品和美容仪器相连接。Olive Young表示，此次扩张也为中小型美容和养生品牌提供了增长机会。公司计划继续凭借零售网络和商品策划能力发掘有潜力的品牌，力争将Olive Better打造为韩国养生文化的展示窗口。一名公司官员表示：“我们正利用积累的养生策划专业能力，继续发展Olive Better，让养生成为客户日常生活中自然而然的一部分。我们将继续扩大实体门店网络，为每个人轻松享受养生生活方式创造更多机会。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title: Overseas trips add to debate over Korea's shifting political standards
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary: President Lee Jae Myung’s overseas trips have again drawn attention to Korea’s shifting political standards, adding to a familiar cycle of disputes over presidential golf and the presidential plane whenever power passes between conservative and liberal administrations. In the latest controversy, National Security Adviser Wi Sung-lac on Friday defended the frequency of Lee’s overseas trips accompanied by first lady Kim Hea Kyung.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 总统李在明的海外出访再次引发了外界对韩国政治标准变化的关注。每当权力在保守派与自由派政府之间交接，围绕总统打高尔夫和总统专机的争议都会按照熟悉的循环再次上演。在最新一轮争议中，国家安全顾问崔承烈于周五为李在明携第一夫人金惠敬频繁出访海外进行辩护。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: President Lee Jae Myung’s overseas trips have again drawn attention to Korea’s shifting political standards, adding to a familiar cycle of disputes over presidential golf and the presidential plane whenever power passes between conservative and liberal administrations. The controversies center on taxpayer money and the public's attitudes toward presidential privilege, with governing parties defending certain activities as necessary for diplomacy or official duties and the opposition calling them wasteful or excessive — arguments that often switch sides under successive administrations. In the latest controversy, National Security Adviser Wi Sung-lac on Friday defended the frequency of Lee’s overseas trips accompanied by first lady Kim Hea Kyung. “Korea’s international standing requires its president to attend regular multilateral gatherings and bilateral visits,” Wi said. “Spouses also accompany leaders as an established diplomatic practice.” Wi’s defense followed an Oct. 1 analysis by Rep. Lee Jin-sook of the main opposition People Power Party (PPP). It counted 14 trips covering 23 countries in Lee’s first 484 days in office, which was more frequent than his two predecessors — conservative Yoon Suk Yeol and liberal Moon Jae-in — over the same period. Yoon was president from May 2022 to April 2025 and Moon from May 2017 to May 2022. At an Oct. 29 parliamentary audit, fellow PPP Rep. Kim Seung-su cited economic hardship in criticizing the frequency of the president’s travel and separately questioned the first lady’s accompaniment. Lee responded on X, formerly Twitter, on Saturday by stressing his demanding schedules and diplomatic results, saying “pigs see only pigs” in rejecting suggestions of tourism. The PPP countered on Sunday by questioning the president's achievements. In particular, the party recalled that the ruling Democratic Party of Korea (DPK) had condemned Yoon’s travel spending as wasteful and his use of contingency funds as undermining parliamentary budget oversight. The reversal was evident in November 2023, when Rep. Hong Ki-won of the DPK contrasted Yoon’s overseas travel budget with cuts to spending on people’s livelihoods. Then-Prime Minister Han Duck-soo rejected the suggestion of waste, while PPP lawmakers defended diplomacy-related expenditures. In November 2024, the DPK dismissed explanations that Yoon was practicing golf to prepare for diplomacy with U.S. President-elect Donald Trump following his reelection. The party urged Yoon to visit people struggling economically instead. With Lee preparing for a possible round of golf with Trump on the occasion of the U.S.-hosted G20 summit in Miami in December, the PPP questioned why preparations ridiculed under Yoon were now justified as diplomacy. Disputes over the presidential plane, known as Code One, stretch back further, with the need to replace aging planes and upgrade onboard facilities. The conservative Grand National Party, a predecessor of the PPP, opposed a proposal to buy a new jet under President Roh Moo-hyun in 2006, citing the needs of impoverished households. When Roh’s conservative successor Lee Myung-bak pursued a purchase in 2008, it stirred objections from the main opposition Democratic Party, a predecessor of the DPK. Under Moon in 2018, DPK lawmakers argued that buying a new plane could improve safety and reduce long-term costs compared with leasing. The government ultimately continued leasing, and the Boeing 747-8i introduced in January 2022 subsequently served Yoon and remains in use under Lee. “The Code One lease shows how investments made by one administration can serve several successors. Nevertheless, parties often oppose such spending for political advantage rather than assess its long-term value,” a political commentator said on condition of anonymity
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 海外出行加剧围绕韩国政治标准变化的争论
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 李在明总统的海外出访再次引发关注，凸显韩国政治标准的变迁。每当保守派与自由派政府之间政权更替，围绕总统高尔夫和总统专机的争议便会循着熟悉的循环再度出现。这些争议的焦点是纳税人资金以及公众对总统特权的态度：执政党将某些活动辩称为外交或公务所必需，反对党则称其浪费或过度——此类论调往往随历届政府更替而倒转。在最新一轮争议中，国家安全顾问魏圣洛于周五为李在明携第一夫人金惠卿频繁出访辩护。魏圣洛表示：“韩国的国际地位要求总统定期参加多边会议并进行双边访问。配偶陪同领导人出席也是一项既定外交惯例。”此前，人民力量党（PPP）主要反对党议员李珍淑于10月1日发表分析，统计李在明任内前484天共出访23国、行程14次，出访频率高于其两位前任——保守派尹锡悦和自由派文在寅——在相同时期内的水平。尹锡悦于2022年5月至2025年4月担任总统，文在寅于2017年5月至2022年5月任总统。在10月29日的国会审计会议上，同属人民力量党的金承秀议员以经济困难为由，批评总统出访频繁，并另行质疑第一夫人陪同出访一事。李在明周六在原Twitter、现更名为X的平台上回应，强调其行程安排繁忙且取得外交成果，并以“猪眼里只有猪”驳斥有关借出访旅游的说法。人民力量党周日则反击，质疑总统的政绩。该党尤其指出，执政的韩国民主党（DPK）曾谴责尹锡悦的旅行开支浪费，并称他动用应急资金削弱了国会对预算的监督。2023年11月，这种立场逆转已十分明显：民主党议员洪基润将尹锡悦的海外旅行预算与削减民生支出进行对比。时任国务卿韩德洙否认存在浪费之说，人民力量党议员则为外交相关开支辩护。2024年11月，民主党驳斥了有关尹锡悦练习高尔夫是为在特朗普再次当选后与其开展外交准备的说法，并敦促尹锡悦去探望经济困难民众。随着李在明准备在12月美国-hosted的迈阿密G20峰会期间与特朗普可能举行一轮高尔夫比赛，人民力量党质疑，为什么在尹锡悦任内遭嘲笑的准备活动如今却被说成外交所必需。围绕被称为“Code One”的总统专机的争议可追溯至更早时期，其背景包括更换老旧飞机和升级机舱设施的需求。人民力量党的前身、保守派大国家党于2006年在卢武铉总统任内反对购买新专机的提案，理由是贫困家庭更需要资金。2008年，卢武铉的保守派继任者李明博推动购买专机，引发主要反对党民主党——民主党前身——的反对。2018年文在寅任内，民主党议员主张，与租赁相比，购买新专机可提高安全性并降低长期成本。政府最终继续采用租赁方式；2022年1月引进的波音747-8i此后先后为尹锡悦和李在明提供专机服务，目前仍在使用。一位要求匿名的政治评论人士表示：“Code One的租赁表明，一届政府进行的投资可以服务于数届继任者。然而，各党常常出于政治上的优势而反对此类开支，而不是评估其长期价值。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/ba.title: KB Kookmin Bank to lead $9.45 bil. AI infrastructure financing
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/ba.summary: KB Kookmin Bank has secured the lead arranger role in a 12.6 trillion won ($9.45 billion) project to build artificial intelligence (AI) computing infrastructure in Korea, the lender said Sunday. As lead arranger, KB Kookmin Bank is overseeing the financing structure, assembling the lending syndicate and coordinating loan terms to secure the necessary funding. Hana Bank, Shinhan Bank, Woori Bank and NH Investment & Securities are also reportedly participating in the financing.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/ba.summary_zh: KB Kookmin Bank已获得一项在韩国建设人工智能（AI）计算基础设施项目的主牵头安排行角色，该项目规模为12.6万亿韩元（94.5亿美元）。该银行周日表示。作为主牵头安排行，KB Kookmin Bank负责统筹融资结构、组建银团并协调贷款条款，以确保筹集所需资金。据报道，Hana Bank、Shinhan Bank、Woori Bank和NH Investment & Securities也参与融资。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/ba.body: KB Kookmin Bank has secured the lead arranger role in a 12.6 trillion won ($9.45 billion) project to build artificial intelligence (AI) computing infrastructure in Korea, the lender said Sunday. Led by Brookfield, one of the world’s largest alternative asset managers, the project involves acquiring major high-performance computing equipment, including graphics processing units (GPUs), and supplying the infrastructure to Naver Cloud. The deal marks the largest syndicated loan arrangement in Korea’s history. Such loans allow multiple financial institutions to jointly finance a large-scale project. It is also the country’s first GPU financing deal — a departure from conventional project financing, which has typically centered on assets like real estate or power plants. Rather than relying on immediate returns, the structure uses anticipated long-term revenue from supplying AI computing capacity to support the project's substantial upfront investment needs. Of the 12.6 trillion won in total costs, roughly 10.7 trillion won will be raised through loans. As lead arranger, KB Kookmin Bank is overseeing the financing structure, assembling the lending syndicate and coordinating loan terms to secure the necessary funding. Hana Bank, Shinhan Bank, Woori Bank and NH Investment & Securities are also reportedly participating in the financing. KB Kookmin Bank said it plans to expand its support for strategic high-tech industries following the deal. “This transaction is significant in that it opens up a new area of financing,” a bank official said. “We will continue to expand our support for industries driving growth ahead and contribute to strengthening the competitiveness of domestic industries by promoting productive finance.”
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/ba.title_zh: KB国民银行将牵头提供94.5亿美元人工智能基础设施融资
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/ba.body_zh: 韩国国民银行宣布，已担任韩国一项价值12.6万亿韩元（94.5亿美元）的人工智能（AI）计算基础设施建设项目的牵头安排行。该银行于周日表示，此项目由全球最大的另类资产管理公司之一Brookfield牵头，涉及收购包括图形处理器（GPU）在内的大型高性能计算设备，并向Naver Cloud提供相关基础设施。这笔交易标志着韩国史上规模最大的银团贷款安排。此类贷款允许多家金融机构共同为大型项目提供融资。这也是韩国首笔GPU融资交易，有别于传统上通常围绕房地产或发电厂等资产展开的项目融资。该融资结构不以即时回报为依据，而是利用提供AI计算容量所预期的长期收入，支撑该项目庞大的前期投资需求。在12.6万亿韩元的总成本中，约10.7万亿韩元将通过贷款筹集。作为牵头安排行，国民银行负责统筹融资架构、组建银团并协调贷款条款，以确保落实所需资金。据报道，Hana Bank、Shinhan Bank、Woori Bank和NH Investment & Securities也参与此次融资。国民银行表示，计划在此次交易后加大对战略高技术产业的支持力度。一名银行官员说：“这笔交易意义重大，为融资开辟了一个新领域。我们将继续扩大对引领增长产业的支持，并通过提供生产性融资，助力提升国内产业的竞争力。”

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nige.summary: The Minister of State for Foreign Affairs, Ambassador Sola Enikanolaiye, made the call while delivering Nigeria’s statement at the Third Russia-Africa Summit at the Grand Kremlin Palace, where he also advocated stronger trade and financial arrangements, including independent local currency settlement mechanisms between both countries.

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nige.body: Layer 1 The Minister of State for Foreign Affairs, Ambassador Sola Enikanolaiye Nigeria has called for a shift in its relations with Russia from political commitments to practical economic cooperation, urging Russian investors to explore opportunities in the country’s energy, solid minerals, agriculture, manufacturing, pharmaceuticals and digital sectors. The Minister of State for Foreign Affairs, Ambassador Sola Enikanolaiye, made the call while delivering Nigeria’s statement at the Third Russia-Africa Summit at the Grand Kremlin Palace, where he also advocated stronger trade and financial arrangements, including independent local currency settlement mechanisms between both countries. Enikanolaiye, who led Nigeria’s delegation to the summit, said the future of Africa- Russia relations must be measured by tangible economic outcomes, stressing the need to translate longstanding diplomatic ties into investments, technology transfer and development partnerships. He said Nigeria was particularly interested in strengthening cross-border payment arrangements with Russia through mutually agreed systems, alongside improved banking channels and financial infrastructure to facilitate trade and investment. The minister, who conveyed President Bola Ahmed Tinubu’s greetings to Russian President Vladimir Putin and the African Union Chairman, President Evariste Ndayishimiye of Burundi, said the private sector must play a greater role in driving the partnership. He urged Russia to collaborate with African countries on commercially viable infrastructure projects covering railways, ports, energy, telecommunications, transport and logistics, noting that such investments would strengthen regional connectivity and support the objectives of the African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA). On the digital economy, Enikanolaiye warned against Africa becoming merely a consumer of imported technology, calling for expanded cooperation in artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, software development, digital infrastructure and joint research. He said such partnerships should prioritise technology transfer, capacity building and the development of indigenous technological capabilities across the continent. The minister also identified agriculture and food security as critical areas for cooperation, urging Russia to support African countries in expanding domestic food production, fertiliser availability, irrigation, mechanisation, agricultural research, storage and agro-processing. According to him, recent disruptions to global supply chains have exposed the vulnerability of food systems, making it imperative for African countries to strengthen domestic production and retain more value from their agricultural resources. On security, Enikanolaiye reaffirmed Nigeria’s commitment to peace and stability in Africa, identifying terrorism, violent extremism, transnational organised crime, arms trafficking, piracy and cybercrime as threats requiring coordinated regional and international responses. He, however, stressed that such partnerships must be anchored on African ownership and African-led solutions, with external cooperation strengthening existing regional mechanisms, including the African Union and ECOWAS. The minister further reiterated Nigeria’s commitment to sovereign equality, territorial integrity, non-interference and the peaceful settlement of disputes, while calling for reforms of the United Nations Security Council and international financial architecture to guarantee Africa’s rightful representation. On the outcome of the summit, Enikanolaiye said Nigeria supported the adoption of a focused Africa-Russia Action Plan for 2027–2029, with clear priorities, financing arrangements and monitoring mechanisms to ensure that agreements translated into measurable results. He specifically invited Russian businesses to take advantage of Nigeria’s position as Africa’s largest market and a strategic gateway to West Africa and the AfCFTA, highlighting opportunities in energy, including renewable and nuclear technology, solid minerals, agriculture, manufacturing, pharmaceuticals, defence and digital services. The minister also said the summit had reinforced the longstanding friendly relations between Nigeria and Russia, recalling Moscow’s historic support for Nigeria’s unity, sovereignty and territorial integrity dating back to the Soviet era. Speaking at the plenary session, Putin described Russia and Africa as natural allies in building a just multipolar world order, reaffirming his country’s commitment to sovereign equality, expanded diplomatic engagement, security cooperation and greater African representation in global institutions. Similarly, Ndayishimiye stressed that Africa would not exchange one form of subordination for another, insisting that the continent’s international partnerships must respect its independence and development priorities. He said the 2027–2029 Action Plan would provide an opportunity to address infrastructure deficits through technology transfer and skills development, while moving Africa from dependence on external assistance towards greater economic independence. The AU chairman also identified water security as a major priority of the continental body’s 2026 agenda. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nige.title_zh: 尼日利亚在莫斯科峰会吸引俄罗斯投资者，并寻求以当地货币结算贸易
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nige.body_zh:
第一层：尼日利亚外交国务部长兼大使 Sola Enikanolaiye 呼吁尼日利亚与俄罗斯的关系从政治承诺转向务实经济合作，并敦促俄罗斯投资者探索该国能源、固体矿产、农业、制造业、制药和数字经济领域的机会。

尼日利亚外交国务部长兼大使 Sola Enikanolaiye 在克里姆林宫举行的第三届俄罗斯—非洲峰会上宣读尼日利亚声明时提出这一主张。他还主张加强贸易和金融安排，包括在两国之间建立独立使用本币的结算机制。

率领尼日利亚代表团出席会议的 Enikanolaiye 表示，非洲与俄罗斯关系的未来必须以切实的经济成果为衡量标准，并强调需要把长期的外交关系转化为投资、技术转让和发展伙伴关系。

他说，尼日利亚尤其希望通过双方商定的机制，加强与俄罗斯之间的跨境支付安排，同时改善银行渠道和金融基础设施，以促进贸易和投资。

这位部长转达了总统 Bola Ahmed Tinubu 对俄罗斯总统 Vladimir普京和非洲联盟主席、burundi总统 Evariste Ndayishimiye 的问候，并表示私营部门必须在推动伙伴关系方面发挥更大作用。

他敦促俄罗斯与非洲国家合作开展具有商业可行性的基础设施项目，涵盖铁路、港口、能源、电信、运输和物流，并指出，此类投资将加强区域互联互通，支持非洲大陆自由贸易区（AfCFTA）的目标。

在数字经济方面，Enikanolaiye 警告称，非洲不能仅仅成为进口技术的消费方，并呼吁扩大人工智能、网络安全、软件开发、数字基础设施和联合研究等领域的合作。

他说，此类伙伴关系应优先推动技术转让、能力建设以及非洲大陆本土技术能力的发展。

这位部长还将农业和粮食安全列为合作的关键领域，敦促俄罗斯支持非洲国家扩大国内粮食生产、提高化肥供应能力、发展灌溉、推进农业机械化，并加强农业研究、储存和农产品加工。

据他介绍，近期全球供应链中断暴露了粮食系统的脆弱性，因此非洲国家必须加强国内生产，并从农业资源中保留更多价值。

在安全问题上，Enikanolaiye 重申尼日利亚致力于维护非洲的和平与稳定，并指出恐怖主义、暴力极端主义、跨国有组织犯罪、军火贩运、海盗行为和网络犯罪都是威胁，需要区域和国际社会采取协调应对措施。

不过，他强调，此类伙伴关系必须以非洲自主权和非洲主导的解决方案为基础，外部合作应当加强包括非洲联盟和西非国家经济共同体在内的现有区域机制。

这位部长还重申尼日利亚致力于实现主权平等、维护领土完整、奉行不干涉原则以及和平解决争端，同时呼吁改革联合国安全委员会和国际金融架构，确保非洲获得应有的代表权。

谈及峰会成果，Enikanolaiye 表示，尼日利亚支持通过一项重点明确的《非洲—俄罗斯2027—2029年行动计划》，并明确优先事项、融资安排和监测机制，以确保各项协议转化为可衡量的成果。

他特别邀请俄罗斯企业利用尼日利亚作为非洲最大市场以及通往西非和非洲大陆自由贸易区战略门户的区位优势，并强调能源（包括可再生能源和核技术）、固体矿产、农业、制造业、制药、国防和数字服务等领域蕴含的机会。

这位部长还表示，本次峰会加强了尼日利亚与俄罗斯之间长期存在的友好关系，并回顾了莫斯科自苏联时期以来对尼日利亚统一、主权和领土完整的历史支持。

普京在全会上发言，将俄罗斯和非洲描述为建设公正多极世界秩序的天然盟友，重申俄罗斯致力于实现主权平等、扩大外交接触、加强安全合作以及推动非洲在全球机构中获得更多代表权。

同样，Ndayishimiye 强调，非洲不会以另一种从属形式取代现有的从属关系，并坚持非洲大陆的国际伙伴关系必须尊重其独立性和发展优先事项。

他说，《2027—2029年行动计划》将提供通过技术转让和技能开发来弥补基础设施缺口的机会，同时推动非洲从依赖外部援助转向实现更大程度的经济独立。

这位非盟主席还将水安全列为该大陆机构2026年议程的一项主要优先事项。

上述内容载于这位部长的媒体与公共传播特助 Richard Elesho 周日发布的一份声明。此处发表的意见不代表《Vanguard》报及其任何员工的观点。

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/bett.body: Layer 1 Former Minister of Humanitarian Affairs and Poverty Reduction, Dr Betta Edu, has set a target of 1.5 million votes from Cross River for President Bola Tinubu, come 2027 general elections. Edu, Co-Chairman of the All Progressives Congress (APC) Women Mobilisation Directorate, made the declaration on Sunday in Calabar, during an empowerment programme that benefited about 500 market women, petty traders and artisans. She said the initiative organised at the instance of the First Lady, Oluremi Tinubu, was designed to improve women’s economic livelihood, and strengthen grassroots mobilisation. She said the beneficiaries received N50,000 each, alongside business and household equipment, including deep freezers, blenders, and toasters. According to her, the intervention targets petty traders whose businesses are constrained by inadequate capital. “Some of them are selling trays that have just N5,000 worth of things on them, while some of them have trays with just N10,000 worth of items on them. “So we are giving these sets of petty traders N50,000 each so that they can expand that their business, build on it, so things can get better for them and their children,” she said. Edu urged residents of the state to support Tinubu, Gov. Bassey Otu and other APC candidates as the party was banking on grassroots women’s mobilisation to strengthen its electoral fortunes in the state. She expressed confidence that the state would deliver more than 1.5 million votes for the ruling party, adding that the directorate was establishing support structures for women across the country. She disclosed that the empowerment programme would be extended to other parts of Cross River, with Abi Local Government Area scheduled to benefit in November or December, while the northern senatorial district would be reached in January. The former minister also highlighted some Federal Government interventions, including the student loan scheme and free maternal healthcare, as measures aimed at improving the welfare of Nigerians. As part of the mobilisation activities, she led members of the directorate on a visit to the General Hospital, Calabar, where they interacted with patients, pregnant women and children receiving treatment and offered financial and emotional support. She said the hospital outreach was undertaken at the instance of the First Lady ahead of the APC rally scheduled to hold in Calabar on Monday. Edu also cited subsidised dialysis services and free maternal healthcare as interventions aimed at improving healthcare access and reducing maternal mortality. One of the beneficiaries, Esther Bassey, a widow from Odukpani Local Government Area, expressed appreciation for the support, saying previous empowerment programmes had helped her cater for her three children. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/bett.body_zh: 第一层：前人道事务与减贫部长贝塔·埃杜博士表示，在2027年大选前，她已为总统博拉·蒂努布设定目标，希望从十字河流州争取150万张选票。埃杜是全进步大会党（APC）妇女动员委员会联席主席。星期日，她在卡拉巴尔举行的一项赋权活动上宣布了这一目标。该活动惠及约500名市场妇女、小商贩和手工艺人。她说，这项由第一夫人奥卢雷米·蒂努布发起组织的举措旨在改善妇女的经济生计，并加强基层动员。她说，每名受益者获得了50,000奈拉，以及商用和家用设备，包括深冷冻柜、搅拌机和烤面包机。据她介绍，这项援助面向因资本不足而经营受限的小商贩。“有些人出售的托盘上只有价值5,000奈拉的商品，而另一些人的托盘上也只有价值10,000奈拉的商品。因此，我们向这些小商贩每人提供50,000奈拉，让她们能够扩大经营、继续发展，从而改善自己和孩子的处境。”埃杜呼吁该州居民支持蒂努布、州长巴塞·奥图以及APC的其他候选人，因为该党指望通过动员基层妇女来增强自身在该州的选举优势。她相信，该州将为执政党投出超过150万张选票，并补充说，该委员会正在全国范围内为妇女建立支持网络。她透露，这项赋权活动将延伸至十字河流州其他地区。阿比地方政府辖区计划于11月或12月受益，而北部参议员选区将在1月得到覆盖。这名前部长还介绍了联邦政府的若干干预措施，包括学生贷款计划和免费孕产妇医疗保健，旨在改善尼日利亚国民的福祉。作为动员活动的一部分，她带领委员会成员探访卡拉巴尔综合医院，与正在接受治疗的患者、孕妇和儿童交流，并提供经济及情感支持。她说，此次医院外展活动是在第一夫人推动下开展的，先于定于星期一在卡拉巴尔举行的APC集会。埃杜还提到补贴透析服务和免费孕产妇医疗保健，认为这些措施旨在改善医疗服务可及性并降低孕产妇死亡率。受益者之一、来自奥杜帕尼地方政府辖区的寡妇埃丝特·巴塞对这项支持表示感谢，并表示此前的赋权计划帮助她养育三个孩子。巴塞承诺在2027年支持APC，称她和家人将投票给该党。此处发表的评论不代表《Vanguard》报及其任何员工的观点
